records.section_heading: American Samoa's island of giants: massive Porites colonies at Ta'u island
records.question: What is the estimated dry weight of the skeleton of the massive Porites colony at Ta'u island?
ground_truth_chunks: The colony is composed of around 200 million polyps, assuming a smooth hemispherical surface and a polyp size of 1 mm<sup>2</sup> , and has a skeletal density of 1.4 g/cm<sup>3</sup> (~52% average porosity).
Using the volume and density estimates, the skeleton was estimated to have a dryweight of approximately 129 metric tons.
